intro: Our Accupadic mattress cradles your body in cloud-like comfort. The supportive base, plush quilted top, and pressure-relieving foam work together for restful sleep and ache-free mornings.

features.title: Foam that helps you rest and recharge
features.text: Wake up refreshed! The convoluted foam melts away pressure points, boosts blood flow, and speeds up muscle recovery—because you deserve deep, uninterrupted relaxation.

features.title: Wake up refreshed with balanced support
features.text: Sink into blissful comfort with medium-firm PU foam that perfectly balances softness and support—so you wake up refreshed and ready to take on the day.

features.title: Plush quilted surface for cozy comfort
features.text: Sink into luxury—this soft knitted fabric top offers a breathable, plush feel, keeping you cool and comfortable through the night.

features.title: Strong layers built to last for years
features.text: Our durable layers protect your mattress from everyday wear, ensuring it holds its shape, supports your spine, and stays luxuriously comfortable for years to come.

features.title: Fits your bed perfectly for peaceful sleep
features.text: Tailor your perfect fit—customisable dimensions ensure your bed feels complete, no matter its shape or size.

name: Accupadic King Bed Foam Mattress
